text: On Monday, Apple announced record fourth-quarter earnings , with total revenue of $114.5B, up 12 percent from the year-ago quarter. iPhone revenue was up 17.5%, Mac revenue was up 23.7%, and Services revenue was up 9.8%. Wearables revenue was down 7.9% and iPad revenue was down 10.4%. Apple execs spent an hour on the phone with financial industry analysts. We’ve got our usual transcript . And I wrote a piece with my overall thoughts on the results and earnings call .
